purpose: Deepen P1C01 living-world routines, local social behavior, bounded context refresh, fauna and environmental motion without increasing the ambient population target or creating a parallel AI brain.

architecture.LivingWorldDirector: Owns population budgets, bounded active-NPC admission/query, pooled lifecycle, micro-events, fauna-group caps, persistent ambient query registration and coarse world response.
architecture.ShireNPCContextSubsystem: Owns bounded NPC context, knowledge, schedules, relationships and reusable behavior snapshots.

runtime_budget.social_query_scope: LivingWorldDirector bounded active query over pooled baseline/micro-event NPCs plus weakly registered persistent builder-authored social residents

canon_boundary: Ambient life never owns or changes locked story outcomes.
NPC knowledge remains gated by existing profile/story contracts.
Fauna/environment motion cannot block required traversal.
acceptance_boundary: SOURCE-IMPLEMENTED / EXACT-HEAD PRE-UNREAL + UE4.27.2 PROOF PENDING. Persistent builder-authored social residents are registered by LivingWorldDirector at committed-world reconciliation; no PIE/device/visual/pacing/performance acceptance is claimed.
